questions.reason: For many-to-one R with total participation of A, every A has exactly one B. Store B's key as a non-null foreign key on A and recover R from the keys in A. The official single-choice key is C.
questions.note: The stem leaves NULL policy unspecified. With D, a nullable foreign key on A also permits the merge in SQL. Recover R from rows with a non-null key. SQLite verified both mappings. C is the official answer and is unique if the stem adds 'without introducing NULLs'.
